test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The simple interest on a certain sum at 10% per annum for two years and three years differ by Rs. 500. Find the sum.
solution:
**Given:**

The simple interest on a certain sum at 10% per annum for two years and three years differ by Rs. 500.

**Concept:**

Simple Interest (SI) is calculated using the formula:

SI = (Principal × Rate × Time) / 100

Calculation:

SI₂ = (P × 10 × 2) / 100

SI₃ = (P × 10 × 3) / 100

Difference between SI for 3 years and 2 years = Rs. 500

⇒ SI₃ - SI₂ = 500

⇒ [(P × 10 × 3) / 100] - [(P × 10 × 2) / 100] = 500

⇒ (30P / 100) - (20P / 100) = 500

⇒ (10P / 100) = 500

⇒ P = 500 × 10

⇒ P = 5000

**∴ The sum is Rs. 5,000.**
